plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points to a congressman named Mike Turner, who represents the Ohio district that contains Wright-Patterson Air Force Base. Michels calls that base the center of UFO lore and of claims about taking apart and copying recovered craft, going back to Roswell, the 1947 New Mexico incident where a craft is said to have crashed. He says that around 2023, while Congress was dealing with a bill that had an eminent domain clause (a provision about the government's power to take private property), Turner's top donors included big defense companies such as Boeing and Lockheed. If that is true, it would suggest that defense industry money shapes how Congress handles UFO secrets.
